table.VID_TOO_BIG: This video is {size}, and this app takes at most {cap} here. Upload it on the page opened on this computer, or send a Google Drive link to it.
table.VID_NO_POST: No post with a script is ready for a video. Write the script first, then send the recording again.
table.VID_PICK_POST:
Which post did you record? Reply with its number:
{list}
table.VID_POST_GONE: That number is not on the list. Reply with a number from 1 to {n}.
table.VID_NOT_STARTED: The video did not start. Open the page to see why.
table.VID_REVIEW_WORDS:
These are the captions. To correct them, reply to the caption card with one line per correction: wrong -> right. When they are right, reply continue.

{words}
table.VID_CUT: The rest of the captions is on the page.
table.VID_EDITED_GATE: Changed. The video will be rendered again and sent for a new approval.
table.VID_NOT_FOUND: "{wrong}" is not in the captions. Copy the words as they are written.
table.VID_AMBIGUOUS: "{wrong}" is in the captions more than once. Add a word before or after it.
table.VID_HOW: Reply continue when the captions are right, or correct them with one line per correction: wrong -> right.
table.VID_RENDERING: Rendering the video. The approval card comes when it is ready.
